title: Weird potions
description: adds a handful of potions, mostly references or weird stuff (obviously)
body:
Adds a handful of cool little potions.
No github page because this is just a quick little data pack that i probably won't return to.

/function weird_potions:help for their commands to give them to you.

the list (all non drinkable ones have the same effects, just different names, you can map their place in the list to their place in the drinkable list):

  Drinkable
  - Beer - Nausea I (1 min)
  - ADHD Medication - Slowness II + Mining Fatigue I (5 min)
  - Bonk! Atomic Punch - Absorption X + Weakness 255 (8 sec)
  - Crit-a-Cola - Strength II (8 sec) + Blindness (12 sec)
  - Funny Juice - Levitation II, Poison IV, Nausea, Mining Fatigue III, Blindness, Hunger II (2 sec)
  - Euthanasia - Wither II + Slowness 255 (infinite)

  Splash
  - Laughing Liquid
  - Serious Liquid
  - Bonk! Atomic Punch
  - Crit-a-Cola
  - DO NOT TOUCH
  - VERY Strong Tear Liquid

  Lingering
  - Laughing Gas
  - Serious Gas
  - Bonk! Atomic Punch
  - Crit-a-Cola
  - Experimental Radioactive Toxin Gas
  - VERY Strong Tear Gas
